notes: Keep route paths, URLs, file paths, shell commands, event IDs, dates, numeric limits, product/provider names, and code identifiers unchanged.
Translate surrounding natural-language text fluently; do not translate strings that consist only of code, symbols, numbers, or identifiers.
Preserve the meaning and all conditions in privacy, account-security, consent, deletion, and service-availability copy. Do not strengthen promises or soften restrictions.
Use the standard native-language name for each platform and interface concept where the English source is plain language.
Use natural, concise UI wording rather than literal word-for-word translations.
